description: Search the bundled OurAirports corpus by exact airport code, free text (name, municipality, keywords), and/or facets (country, region, type). All query terms must match. Text supports forward prefixes and common abbreviations such as intl. Exact code matches lead code-only searches, followed by ranked summaries favoring operational and larger airports. Use ourairports_get_airport for full records by code, ourairports_list_countries for valid country and region codes, and ourairports_find_airports for nearest airports. OurAirports is community-edited — not authoritative for flight operations.

country.description: Country code from ourairports_list_countries (e.g. US). Case-insensitive; surrounding whitespace is ignored. Literal empty string is unset; whitespace-only is invalid.

include_closed.description: Include airports of type "closed". Off by default — closed airports pollute the live-flight grounding use case.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Defaults to OURAIRPORTS_DEFAULT_SEARCH_LIMIT (20), up to 100. Larger positive integers clamp to 100 with a notice; OURAIRPORTS_CLAMP_LIMITS=false restores strict rejection.

offset.description: Matching airports to skip. Defaults to 0. Use nextOffset to continue.

query.description: Exact IATA, ICAO, GPS, local code or ident, or text from an airport name, municipality, or keywords. Omit to browse by facets.

anyOf.description: Region code with one or two segments.

region.description: Region code from ourairports_list_countries with include_regions (e.g. US-WA or KS-U-A). Case-insensitive; surrounding whitespace is ignored. Literal empty string is unset; whitespace-only is invalid.

type.description: Restrict to one airport type: large_airport, medium_airport, small_airport, heliport, seaplane_base, balloonport, or closed.

name: ourairports_search_airports

airports.description: Matching airports, ranked best-first. Codes the airport lacks are null.

items.description: An airport summary with its full (sparse) code set and coordinates.

continent.description: Two-letter continent code (AF, AN, AS, EU, NA, OC, SA), or null.

countryName.description: Resolved country name, or null when the country code is unknown.

elevationFt.description: Field elevation in feet, or null when unknown.

iataCode.description: 3-letter IATA code, or null when the airport has none (~89% of fields).

icaoCode.description: 4-letter ICAO code, or null when the airport has none (~88% of fields).

id.description: OurAirports internal integer id (the join key for runways/frequencies).

ident.description: OurAirports universal identifier — globally unique; often equals the ICAO or GPS code.

isoCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or null.

isoRegion.description: ISO 3166-2 region code (e.g. US-WA), or null.

keywords.description: Recorded aliases and other search keywords, or null.

localCode.description: National/local code (e.g. FAA LID), or null.

regionName.description: Resolved region name, or null when the region code is unknown.

scheduledService.description: True when the airport has scheduled airline service.

type.description: Airport type: large_airport, medium_airport, small_airport, heliport, seaplane_base, balloonport, or closed.

cap.description: The limit that was applied. Present only when results were truncated.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_country`: The country code is absent from the bundled country table. `unknown_region`: The region code is absent from the bundled region table. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next page with the same query.

notice.description: Guidance for an empty page, continuation, or a clamped limit.

shown.description: Number of airports returned. Present only when results were truncated.

totalCount.description: Total matching airports before offset and limit.

truncated.description: Present and true only when matches remain after this page.

title: Search Airports
